SELECT T.* FROM T_CORE_TABLE T
ORDER BY
T.ID

SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT C.TABLE_NAME TABLENAME, COALESCE(D.VALUE, '') FIELDCOMMENT, C.COLUMN_NAME FIELDNAME, UPPER(C.DATA_TYPE) FIELDTYPE, CASE C.DATA_TYPE WHEN 'varchar' THEN LTRIM(STR(C.CHARACTER_MAXIMUM_LENGTH)) ELSE '' END FIELDLENGTH, CASE C.IS_NULLABLE WHEN 'YES' THEN '1' ELSE '0' END ALLOWNULL, REPLACE(COALESCE(C.COLUMN_DEFAULT, ''), '''', '') DEFAULTVALUE, C.NUMERIC_PRECISION PRECISION, C.NUMERIC_SCALE SCALE FROM SYS.COLUMNS B LEFT JOIN SYS.EXTENDED_PROPERTIES D ON D.MAJOR_ID = B.OBJECT_ID AND D.MINOR_ID = B.COLUMN_ID LEFT JOIN INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS C ON C.COLUMN_NAME = B.NAME AND B.OBJECT_ID = OBJECT_ID(C.TABLE_NAME) LEFT JOIN (SELECT T.NAME TABLE_NAME, T.OBJECT_ID FROM SYS.TABLES T) V ON B.OBJECT_ID = V.OBJECT_ID AND C.TABLE_NAME = V.TABLE_NAME ) T
